dependency_aware_build_command_from_work: corepack pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=imported-skill-example
targeted_fixture_rebuild_command_from_wo: corepack pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=imported-skill-example --force
notes: Install only prepares dependencies; it does not build workspace exports.
Use the root Turbo build with a package filter so turbo.jsonc build.dependsOn ["^build"] builds workspace prerequisites before the imported-skill example.
Create a new unique owned runtime root for each live run, or refuse an existing destination; do not auto-delete earlier runs.
Stage the selected fixture by copying only SKILL.md, CHECKLIST.txt, and STYLE.txt into the owned copy before building.
Use --force only for actual fixture reruns in the same owned copy.
Do not use corepack pnpm --filter imported-skill-example build as the clean-workspace verification command, and do not place a literal -- before Turbo's --filter option.
not_run_reason: Complete install/build/runtime verification requires a prepared and authorized workspace.
